query:
SELECT u.id, u.name, u.email, u.userType, mp.id as mentee_profile_id, mp.school, mp.region
FROM users u
JOIN mentee_profiles mp ON u.id = mp.userId
ORDER BY u.createdAt DESC
LIMIT 10;
